title: Compatible Distributions of the Oracle Regime Outcome in Sequential Multiple Assignment Randomized Trials
banked_reason: D0.5 field-floor failure: standard FFRCISTG does not imply the shared cross-regime prefixes required for the claimed sharp projection; the strongest honest same-assumption result is a subfield inner/outer sandwich (paper-score ceiling 6.9 below 7.4).
gap_reasons: standard FFRCISTG single-world conditional laws do not imply an a.s. shared cross-regime prefix, so Theta(P) subset proj_q R(P) is unproved
The cross-world-prefix objection is load-bearing and cannot be repaired under ordinary FFRCISTG without adding a crux-encoding prefix-consistency assumption.

The strongest faithful same-assumption salvage is the constructive-inner/Shahn-outer sandwich, which the cold referee grades subfield with paper_score_ceiling 6.9 below the field threshold 7.4 and explicitly marks salvageable=false.
proof_attempt_summary: The run proved the local discrete maximum-law characterization and built a tree-linear constructive inner polytope with exact LP certificates and samplers. The advertised equality with the full FFRCISTG identified set collapsed because its reverse inclusion requires shared cross-regime prefixes that ordinary single-world FFRCISTG assumptions do not supply; adding them would encode the crux. What remains sound is the subfield sandwich between the constructive inner polytope, the causal identified set, and Shahn's outer envelope, plus the K=3 inner-versus- outer strictness witness; no formalization stage ran under the temporary freeze.
tldr: In a finite SMART, the observed law identifies each regime-outcome marginal but not the dependence needed for the perfect-information outcome \(M_Q=\max_{d\in\mathcal D}Y(d)\). The project characterizes every compatible discrete oracle-outcome pmf through local maximum-law capacity inequalities recursively linked over the full-history tree. Its field-tier headline is a projection-and-lift theorem universal over observed laws obeying known positive randomization: each recursively feasible array extends to one complete law \(Q\) preserving that observed margin, with consistency, exchangeability, single-world factorization, and reached-history modularity imposed on \(Q\). A separate kernel-extension lemma completes dormant zero-probability fibers without strengthening the causal model. Corollaries give a tree-sized polytope, exact certificates, attaining samplers, an explicit strictly nonrectangular positive witness, and finite-sample whole-set confidence inversion for oracle remission in SMART-BD.
gap: Static sharp distributional bounds characterize pointwise limits for functions of two potential outcomes, and published oracle-DTR bounds identify sharp binary endpoints and two simultaneous CDF envelopes. Neither literature characterizes all attainable discrete oracle laws or verifies a complete dormant-branch lift for every interior law.
fill: For every observed law obeying known positive randomization, the tree-diagonal projection theorem equates this recursion with complete FFRCISTG laws whose observed margin is fixed and on which consistency, exchangeability, factorization, and reached-history modularity hold. A theorem-level finite kernel-extension argument coordinates null-fiber versions after the substantive lift, and the resulting corollaries compress the sharp set and map simultaneous multinomial uncertainty through the same program.
